# Repository instructions

This repository contains the `problem-framing` and `scrollytelling-article` product design skills, together with explanatory materials.

When a user asks to define, challenge, review, or reframe a product problem—either before solution work or while a project is already in progress—use the workflow in @.github/skills/problem-framing/SKILL.md.

When a user asks for an interactive article, scrollytelling experience, scroll-triggered explainer, narrative script, or a long-form page whose visuals change with the story, use @.github/skills/scrollytelling-article/SKILL.md. Preserve its approval gate: agree on the narrative and visual script before implementing the article.

Treat `FRAMED_PROBLEM.md` as the skill's primary output and as persistent project context. Do not collapse observations, interpretations, assumptions, commitments, and preferences into a single category. Ask one high-leverage question at a time, inspect available project context before asking for facts, and request research-library or metrics inputs only when they can change the frame or next decision.

Keep the skill platform-neutral. Do not introduce vendor-specific metadata or references unrelated to GitHub Copilot repository conventions.

When updating either skill, keep its YAML frontmatter valid. Keep the problem-framing scrollytelling and narrative script aligned with material workflow or terminology changes.
